commits.message: The hanging whitespace test renders the text itself, since print sets its own overflow and justify (rich-control-codes-xh4n.5do)

A break, a measure and a document each read what is drawn (rich-control-codes-xh4n.5do)

High review of #535. A run's start is no break, a mark with no text before it
neither; a zero-width code point after a wrap's whitespace is not content; a
text's edge is the last thing drawn; a value's own separator lays out as an LF;
JSON has one escape pass over the census; the two per-render fast paths return.

Format characters keep their meaning in content, and their abuse is contained (rich-control-codes-xh4n.5do)

The census gains two dispositions. `line-break` turns U+2028 and U+2029 into an
LF at the content boundary, code unit for code unit, so every reader of a Text
finds one line ending. `withheld` covers the soft hyphen, tag characters and
variation selectors: content keeps them, and `replaceWithheld` decides from their
neighbours what reaches the wire. It runs in `sealed`, on text nothing cuts again,
so a rule that reads context cannot move an offset. `cellLen` measures what it
leaves, and a deletion keeps every cluster boundary the text had, so a cut stays
exact.

The wrapper breaks where a word's own text says it may: after ZWSP, at a soft
hyphen, which draws as `-` only at a break it took, and between the words of Thai,
Lao, Khmer and Burmese. U+FEFF stops counting as a space, which was JavaScript's
`\s` departing from Rich by accident. JSON escapes whatever content or the wire
would drop, so it parses back to its data.

Departures from Rich: a soft hyphen measures 0 rather than 1, and a U+2028 in a
JSON string prints as an escape. docs/control-codes.md records each family and
what tmux, Terminal.app, iTerm2 and xterm.js were measured doing.

Bidi controls take effect inside the content that holds them, and right-to-left text reads correctly (rich-unfiled-791c.zzmy) (#534)

* UAX #9 resolves a paragraph's levels and a line's visual order, proven on the UCD's conformance data (rich-unfiled-791c.zzmy)

* Bidi controls take effect inside the content holding them, and a terminal's text order decides what reaches the wire (rich-unfiled-791c.zzmy)

* Right-to-left text is proved on the wire, a real emulator and a browser, and documented (rich-unfiled-791c.zzmy)

* Direction state ends where rendering ends it, on every path into a Text (rich-unfiled-791c.zzmy)

High review of #534. A line is the paragraph, so advance stops resetting at
U+2029, which paragraph resolves inside the line: an override that survived it
was invisible to closed. assemble's strings and tuples and Pretty's symbols,
function names, opaque names and thrown messages all close now.

A closer after a wrap's whitespace no longer reads as content, clusters are
found across a row's spans so a mark keeps its letter, a ZWJ inside a letter's
cluster joins forward, and edgeStyle reports the cells drawn at the edge.
Neovim and Vim terminals are plain. Openers are read off one pass over the
line, so logical wrapping is linear again.

* Long lines resolve, Markdown spans and tokens are their own content, and appends stay linear (rich-unfiled-791c.zzmy)

Medium review of #534. A level run no longer spreads into a call, which threw
on a 200,000 character line holding one isolate. Each inline node of Markdown
and each token closes what it left open, and inline code deletes the controls
a code block does. append remembers the text it closed, so a run of appends
reads nothing twice. A row spliced into goes on from what it left open.

plainOf has one home on Segment, and segmentToString says a row is encoded
whole.

* Wrapped right-to-left rows start at their edge, and hostile nesting costs linear time (rich-unfiled-791c.zzmy)

Second high review of #534. A row a wrap closed loses its hanging whitespace
before it is ordered, since L1 stood it at a right-to-left row's left edge.
Openers are read forward and a row reopens at most MAX_DEPTH of them, and an
isolate count takes the scan out of an unmatched PDI. append carries the tail
it has not closed, so alternating string and Text appends stay linear.

Pretty's non-string class name and JSON's undefined draw as they did on master.
An edge is a cell drawn, never a control.

The row-continuation map in sealed goes: it cost a stale-state bug for a case
nobody reproduced, and containment does not need it. docs states the limit.
